subject: Urgent: candidate hospitalization — options to convert interview (recording / take-home / reschedule)
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@gmail.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: recruiting@talenthub.io
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interview today at 10:30 — emergency

Hi Markus,

I'm so sorry to send this last minute — I was in a minor car accident this morning and have been checked into the ER for observation (minor concussion, nothing life-threatening). My doctor advised I shouldn't be on video or do intensive coding right now. I know I have the on-site coding + system design interview with your team at 10:30 PT.

If possible, I would like one of the following:
- Reschedule for next week (any day except Friday); or
- Do a take-home coding exercise (I can complete within 48 hours); or
- If the team can, record a short supervised codewalk (I can read and narrate, but can't be on camera for long).

Really appreciate the team's flexibility — I want to be respectful of everyone's time. Happy to provide a quick note from the clinic if needed.

Thank you,
Lina Torres
(415) 555-0192
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@gmail.com>, recruiting@talenthub.io
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Interview today at 10:30 — emergency

Team — forwarding Lina's note. She's in the ER and can't do the live session. Can we triage options quickly? My suggested priorities:

1) Offer take-home exercise with 48-hour deadline (attached instructions) — lowest friction for candidate and interviewers.
2) If Marissa is comfortable, swap to a recorded codewalk: Marissa runs the prompt, we record audio + screenshare (Lina states she can't be on camera much) — then debrief asynchronously.
3) If neither works, reschedule to next week (avoid Friday).

Marissa, can you take the recorded option if needed? Connor, are you available to cover half of the 60-min slot if we keep a short live interview (15–20 min) later today?

I will reply to Lina with the options and attach the take-home instructions so she can pick.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Sr. Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@gmail.com>, recruiting@talenthub.io
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Interview today at 10:30 — emergency

Thanks for the heads up. I can do the recorded codewalk option if Lina is able to narrate without being on camera; I can run the exercise and capture audio + screen.

If she prefers the take-home we should send the instructions immediately. No problem rescheduling if she's not up for anything today — happy to move my availability to Tuesday/Wednesday morning next week.

Connor — I can take the system-design portion; if you want to cover 15–20 minutes of the coding portion today, that could work as a short live check, but only if Lina confirms she's comfortable.

-Marissa
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, recruiting@talenthub.io
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interview today at 10:30 — emergency

Hi Lina — I’m sorry to hear about the accident and hope you’re okay. We definitely want you to rest and recover. Quick options so you can pick what works best: 

A) Take-home exercise: attached "takehome-instructions.pdf". Comfortable deadline would be 48 hours from your sign-off (we can extend if needed).

B) Recorded codewalk: Marissa can run the prompt on a screenshare and record audio while you narrate (no camera required). That will allow the team to hear your thought process and give us a debrief.

C) Reschedule: we have openings Tuesday/Wednesday next week (10–2 PT). Let us know preferred day(s).

If you can reply here with your choice I’ll make the arrangements immediately. Also happy to accept a quick clinic note if you want to share it for our records. Take care — no pressure on timing.

Best,
Markus
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@gmail.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, recruiting@talenthub.io
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interview today at 10:30 — emergency

Thank you all for the quick responses and for understanding. I chatted with the ER nurse and I'm still feeling fuzzy — I think the take-home is the best option for me right now. I can complete the exercise within 48 hours, but would request a 72-hour window if that's possible given my current grogginess.

I'll sign the take-home instructions and begin once you confirm the extended deadline. I can also send a clinic note if you need one.

Appreciate your flexibility — Lina
